edges.reason: creator parameter drives the creatorAdminRequired gate and series bookkeeping in createSeries.
maxSupply_ parameter is written to _maxSupply[creator][series].
prefix parameter is written to _tokenPrefix[creator][series].
series/prefix parameters update _tokenPrefix in setTokenURIPrefix.
tokenId parameter feeds tokenURI string construction.
tokenId parameter is scanned against _indexRanges in _tokenSeriesAndIndex.
series selection flags are evaluated against the random seed in tokenCheck.
recipient parameter is forwarded to the external mintExtensionBatch call.
msg.sender must be creator admin and is the withdrawal recipient.
msg.sender is mixed into the randomness seed.
block.timestamp is used directly as randomness entropy.
Timestamp dependency enables miner-influenced randomness.
Random seed determines which series is selected in tokenCheck.
Random seed drives the selectedSeries value in mintGLFX01.
statusCheck summation over _totalSupply gates the series selection logic.
random() produces the seed stored in randomSeed.
mintGLFX01 calls tokenCheck to pick a series.
mintGLFX01 falls back to tokenCheck2 when no series matched.
mintGLFX01 updates index ranges and supply after minting.
mintGLFX01 performs the external mintExtensionBatch call.
tokenCheck requests a random seed.
tokenCheck2 requests a random seed.
tokenURI resolves series and index via _tokenSeriesAndIndex.
_tokenSeriesAndIndex reads _indexRanges to map tokenId to series.
_updateIndexRanges increments _totalSupply[creator][series].
_updateIndexRanges appends or merges entries in _indexRanges.
createSeries increments _currentSeries[creator] by one.
createSeries writes the new series counter to _currentSeries.
latestSeries reads _currentSeries.
totalSupply reads _totalSupply.
maxSupply reads _maxSupply.
Native transfer to msg.sender can re-enter withdraw before state/funds settle.
External call to an arbitrary creator contract may re-enter mintGLFX01.
mintRate is compared against msg.value in mintGLFX01.

normalization_plan.reason: The creator address parameter is only meaningful as the access-controlled argument of the creator functions.
maxSupply_ is a transient argument written straight into _maxSupply by createSeries.
prefix is a transient URI string absorbed into _tokenPrefix.
The series argument exists only to index the prefix mapping inside setTokenURIPrefix.
tokenId only flows through the tokenURI/_tokenSeriesAndIndex lookup.
Series flags are consumed by the random selection logic in tokenCheck/tokenCheck2.
recipient is forwarded to the external mint call initiated by mintGLFX01.
statusCheck is a scratch accumulator computed and consumed entirely inside mintGLFX01.
selectedSeries is a temporary result used only to drive _updateIndexRanges from mintGLFX01.
randomSeed is the derived output local of random() and has no independent lifetime.
The local series variable is the return value computed by tokenCheck/tokenCheck2.
